versions.changelog:
Starloop Skill v0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Reads a StarFocus todo folder and filters todos by star role (optional).
- Ranks todos using strategic priority, starPoints, and urgency context files.
- Assesses each todo for feasibility and filters out blocked tasks, noting missing capabilities.
- Outputs a concise, actionable Telegram markdown recommendation with up to 3 candidates and reasons.
- Includes guidance on resolving blocked high-priority todos with relevant ClawHub search results.
- Always references todos by their full unique-ID-suffixed filenames.
